description: Sign in to Microsoft Teams, inspect bounded chat history, and send only to an explicitly owner-approved chat.
configHelp: Chat-first setup: the user is in this chat, so ask and show everything here. 1. Run `codeterm plugin teams-client login`. On first use it installs the pinned m365 CLI into this instance's plugin runtime directory (needs Node.js 20+ and npm) and reports an install state; that is expected. Keep polling `codeterm plugin teams-client login-status`. 2. When the result's `signIn` is `browser`, a Microsoft sign-in page has opened in the user's default browser: tell the user in chat to sign in there with their Microsoft 365 work or school account (a tenant administrator may need to approve the m365 CLI app's consent). If a result instead carries `signInUrl` and `deviceCode`, show both prominently in chat: the URL as a clickable link and the code on its own line in bold and in a code span. 3. Keep polling `login-status` until `done` is true, then confirm with `codeterm plugin teams-client health` and `codeterm plugin teams-client accounts`. If a step returns an error, show it in chat and say what the user can do. Agent verbs: `accounts`, `use <account-id>`, `chats`, `history <chat-id> [n]`, `health`, `logout`, `login`, `login-status`, `preview <chat-id> <text>`, `send <chat-id> [--key <idempotency-key>] <text>`. Sending stays closed until the owner refreshes chats, inspects a preview including sender tenant and exact text, and explicitly approves that one chat in the view. There is no default send policy. History is capped at 50 messages and 32 KiB.
